pages.name: Dish

componentSources.DishCard:
Component(
  id: "corpus/dish-card",
  name: "DishCard",
  kind: Kind.section,
  description: "A dish, passed in.",
)

Options(
  product<Product>(required: true),
  categories<Category[]>(),
  title: String(label: "Title", maxLength: 40, default: "Dish"),
)

Build(
  Column(gap: Space.sm, children: [
    Text(child: options.title, size: FontSize.sm),
    Text(child: options.product.name, weight: FontWeight.bold),
    Text(child: formatMoney(options.product.display_price_cents)),
  ])
)
